ecg_reference_pathway.method: Pan–Tompkins QRS detection (1985): 5–15 Hz bandpass, derivative, squaring, 150 ms integration, adaptive thresholding, 200 ms refractory, R-peak refinement
ecg_reference_pathway.why_separate: research/rppg/dataset_io.py rejects ECG references with ecg_rpeak_estimator_unavailable; that behaviour is preserved and this pathway is the only ECG reader, feeding references after estimation

quality_gates.note: unchanged for this dataset; failures yield bpm=None

blocking_reason: Dataset not present in this environment. The readiness adapter, ECG reference pathway, frozen protocol and dataset-independent tests are complete; the benchmark itself is NOT RUN.
limitations: 26 participants (Subject_4 excluded by the provider), predominantly young Portuguese university students; Fitzpatrick I–IV only (no V/VI). No generalisation beyond this population.
Single-site acquisition: one room, natural indoor daylight, 10:00–16:00, one webcam type, participants seated and asked to stay still. No claim about other lighting, motion or devices.
64×64 ROI crops with consumer compression: fine pulsatile detail is limited by the provider's anonymisation pipeline, not by this implementation.
Video/ECG synchronisation is manual with a documented uncertainty of up to ±500 ms; this protocol therefore evaluates 30 s windows, not sub-second timing.
The ECG reference is a pulse-rate reference derived from R-peaks. Agreement with it is NOT validation of pulse-rate variability, HRV, or any clinical parameter.
Non-commercial licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): results are research-use only and share-alike terms apply to redistribution of derived data.
